description: This file defines classes and constants for handling WebIDL types, including various IDL type classes, union types, array types, and related utilities. It is part of a codebase that processes or generates code based on WebIDL specifications.

classes.name: IdlTypeBase
classes.description: Base class for various IDL type representations, providing common interface and default behaviors.

classes.name: IdlType
classes.description: Represents a basic IDL type with properties to determine its characteristics, such as whether it is a callback, dictionary, enum, or primitive type.

classes.name: IdlUnionType
classes.description: Represents a union of multiple IDL types, with methods to flatten nested unions and analyze nullable types.

classes.name: IdlArrayOrSequenceType
classes.description: Base class for array-like IDL types, including array, sequence, and frozen array types.

classes.name: IdlFrozenArrayType
classes.description: Represents an IDL frozen array type.

classes.name: IdlRecordType
classes.description: Represents a record (dictionary) IDL type with key and value types.

classes.name: IdlNullableType
classes.description: Wraps another IDL type to indicate nullability.

classes.name: IdlPromiseType
classes.description: Represents a Promise IDL type, added in Cobalt.

methods.name: inherits_interface
methods.description: Checks if an interface inherits from an ancestor.

methods.name: set_ancestors
methods.description: Sets the inheritance relationships between interfaces.
